sections.name: File setup
sections.title: File header and type import
sections.what: Explains that this file holds firm branding text and that each deployment can replace it. It also brings in the type that describes taxonomy sources.
sections.why: The header says brand strings belong in this file rather than inside components.
sections.watch_out: A replacement file must keep the same exported names, or the pages that import them will fail.

sections.name: BRAND
sections.title: Brand name and confidentiality notices
sections.what: Holds the organisation name, the upper-case wordmark used on slide title pages, and two confidentiality notices. One notice is printed on slide footers and the other on the tool landing pages.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeping the name and notices in one place lets a deployment change them everywhere at once.
sections.watch_out: The two notices are worded differently. It is unclear whether that is intended, so check with the owner before any legal wording change.

sections.name: BRAND_TAXONOMY_FIRMS, BRAND_TAXONOMY_SOURCES
sections.title: Extra firm and source lists
sections.what: Two empty lists that a deployment can fill to add extra consulting firm groupings and extra taxonomy sources. They are empty here, so nothing extra is added by default.
sections.why: The comments say they extend the taxonomy note and the taxonomy sources.
sections.watch_out: The code that merges these lists is not shown, so a duplicate key could override a default entry; this is unverified.

summary: Holds the brand name, the wordmark and the confidentiality notices shown in the web app and on slides, plus two empty lists a deployment can fill.
purpose: Keeps all firm-facing branding text in one file so a deployment can change it without editing pages.
why: The file header says it is per-deployment and that brand strings belong here rather than inside components.
how: 1. Define one object named BRAND with the name, the wordmark and two confidentiality notices. 2. Export two empty lists for extra consulting firms and extra taxonomy sources. 3. Pages import these values and display them.
inputs: Nothing at run time. A deployment edits or replaces this file before building.
outputs: Three exports: BRAND, BRAND_TAXONOMY_FIRMS and BRAND_TAXONOMY_SOURCES.
risks: Wrong wording could appear on client slides. Renaming an export would break every page that imports it.
debug: If a name or footer looks wrong, check this file first, then search the components for the text to see which value they use. If the build fails on imports, check the export names.
